claim: On May 1, 2025 CloudWatch launched volume tiered pricing for AWS Lambda logs and added Amazon S3 and Amazon Data Firehose as Lambda log delivery destinations.
question: When did CloudWatch add volume tiered pricing for Lambda logs?

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch launches tiered pricing and additional destinations for AWS Lambda logs

evidence.quote: Today, Amazon CloudWatch launched volume tiered pricing for AWS Lambda logs and support for additional delivery destinations.
Additionally, CloudWatch now supports Amazon S3 and Amazon Data Firehose as Lambda log delivery destinations.

note: Current truth: cloudwatch-delivery-class... see the Delivery log class fact cloudwatch-logs-delivery-class-two-days-fixed-retention for the log class used to deliver Lambda logs to S3 or Firehose.

claim: On Sep 17, 2025 CloudWatch launched cross-account and cross-Region log centralization; one copy of the logs is centralized for free and additional copies, including a backup Region, are charged per GB.
question: When did CloudWatch add cross-account cross-Region log centralization, and is the first copy free?

values.display: centralize one copy of logs for free

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch launches Cross-Account and Cross-Region Log Centralization

evidence.quote: Amazon CloudWatch now offers cross-account and cross-region log centralization, allowing customers to copy log data from multiple AWS accounts and regions into a single destination account.
Customers can centralize one copy of logs for free. Additional copies are charged at $0.05/GB of logs centralized (the backup region feature is considered an additional copy).

claim: On Nov 26, 2025 CloudWatch added deletion protection for log groups: once enabled, a log group cannot be deleted until the protection is explicitly turned off.
question: When did CloudWatch add deletion protection for log groups?

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch now supports deletion protection for logs

evidence.quote: Once enabled, log groups cannot be deleted until the protection is explicitly turned off, helping safeguard critical operational, security, and compliance data.

claim: On Feb 10, 2026 CloudWatch added Alarm Mute Rules, which temporarily mute alarm notifications during planned deployments, maintenance windows and off-hours.
question: When did CloudWatch add Alarm Mute Rules?

evidence.heading: AWS CloudWatch Alarm Mute Rules eliminate alert fatigue

evidence.quote: Amazon CloudWatch now supports Alarm Mute Rules, enabling customers to temporarily mute alarm notifications during planned deployments, maintenance windows, and off-hours without compromising monitoring visibility.

note: Current truth: cloudwatch-alarm-mute-rules-mute-actions-in-time-windows (behavior) and cloudwatch-quota-alarm-mute-rules (2,000 per Region).

claim: On Jun 15, 2026 CloudWatch Query Studio became generally available; it queries OpenTelemetry and AWS vended metrics with PromQL or Metrics Insights.
question: When did CloudWatch Query Studio become generally available?

values.display: general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Query Studio

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch Query Studio is now generally available

evidence.quote: Today, Amazon Web Services announces the general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Query Studio, a unified querying and visualization experience that enables you to explore metrics from a single interface within the CloudWatch console.

note: General availability before the 2026-07-15 cut, so examinable by the date rule, but new: put it under Changed recently.

claim: On Jun 15, 2026 CloudWatch Metrics Centralization became generally available: it replicates CloudWatch metrics cross-account and cross-Region into a single destination account.
question: When did CloudWatch metrics centralization become generally available?

values.display: replicate CloudWatch metrics cross-account and cross-region

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch now supports cross-account metrics centralization

evidence.quote: Today, Amazon Web Services announces the general availability of Amazon CloudWatch Metrics Centralization, which enables you to replicate CloudWatch metrics cross-account and cross-region into a single destination account.

claim: On Sep 1, 2026 CloudWatch added warm-up periods for metric alarms and log alarms, which delay alarm evaluation for a set time after the alarm is created. Not examinable yet.
question: When did CloudWatch add alarm warm-up periods?

values.display: delaying alarm evaluation for a set time

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch now supports warm-up periods for alarms

evidence.quote: Amazon CloudWatch now lets you configure a warm-up period for metric alarms and log alarms, delaying alarm evaluation for a set time after the alarm is created.

note: not examinable yet: general availability after 2026-07-15. The What's New URL path says 2026/08; the post date is Sep 1, 2026. Duration range: cloudwatch-alarm-warm-up-duration-range.

claim: On Aug 7, 2026 CloudWatch alarms added wall clock evaluation windows that align alarm evaluation to fixed calendar boundaries such as the top of the hour, midnight or the start of the week. Not examinable yet.
question: When did CloudWatch alarms add wall clock evaluation windows?

values.display: align alarm evaluations to fixed calendar boundaries

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudWatch Alarms now supports wall clock evaluation windows

evidence.quote: Today, Amazon CloudWatch announces wall clock evaluation windows for metric alarms, enabling customers to align alarm evaluations to fixed calendar boundaries such as the top of the hour, midnight, or the start of the week.

note: not examinable yet: general availability after 2026-07-15. The What's New URL path says 2026/07; the post date is Aug 7, 2026. The default remains the sliding window (alarm-evaluation page).
